standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, Lemma labelled lemma-mayer-vietoris (source line 767, Stacks tag 01EB); invoked at proof line 842, and its proof is where the displayed degreewise short exact sequence was established
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the degreewise exactness of the sequence of sections over f^{-1}(W), which is what makes the sequence of complexes of direct images exact.

standard_prerequisites.name: Cohomology of an open subspace is computed by restriction of an injective resolution
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, Lemma labelled lemma-cohomology-of-open (source line 496, Stacks tag 01E1); invoked at proof lines 844-846
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies that the restrictions of an injective resolution are injective resolutions of the restricted modules, which identifies the cohomology sheaves appearing in the long exact sequence with the higher direct images.

core_obligations: Reduce to an exact sequence of complexes of direct images: for an injective resolution F -> I^bullet and for every open W of Y and every n, write down the sequence 0 -> I^n(f^{-1}(W)) -> I^n(U cap f^{-1}(W)) plus I^n(V cap f^{-1}(W)) -> I^n(U cap V cap f^{-1}(W)) -> 0 and note that it is short exact by the proof of the absolute Mayer-Vietoris lemma (proof lines 822-842).

Identify the resulting sequence of complexes: taking sections over all opens W gives the claimed short exact sequence 0 -> f_*I^bullet -> a_*(I^bullet|_U) plus b_*(I^bullet|_V) -> c_*(I^bullet|_{U cap V}) -> 0 of complexes of sheaves on Y (proof lines 824-831).

Read off the long exact sequence: the restrictions of I^bullet to U, V and U cap V are injective resolutions of the corresponding restrictions of F, so taking cohomology sheaves of the short exact sequence produces the displayed sequence ending in R^1 f_* F and beyond (proof lines 843-846).
proof_roadmap: Fix an injective resolution of F and check the degreewise sequence of sections over f^{-1}(W) is short exact, quoting the proof of the absolute Mayer-Vietoris lemma (proof lines 822-842).
Assemble those degreewise sequences into a short exact sequence of complexes of direct images on Y (proof lines 824-831).
Take cohomology sheaves and use that restriction of the resolution resolves the restricted module, to obtain the relative long exact sequence (proof lines 843-846).
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives the relative Mayer-Vietoris sequence 0 -> f_*F -> a_*(F|_U) plus b_*(F|_V) -> c_*(F|_{U cap V}) -> R^1 f_*F -> ... for a morphism of ringed spaces f : X -> Y and a cover of X by two open subsets, functorially in F (statement lines 805-818). The proof works on the level of an injective resolution: the absolute Mayer-Vietoris proof is reused to see that the degreewise sequence of sections over f^{-1}(W) is short exact for every open W, which yields a short exact sequence of complexes of direct images, and the identification of the cohomology sheaves with the higher direct images rests on the separate statement that restrictions of the resolution are again injective resolutions (proof lines 822-846). The functoriality assertion is carried over from the absolute statement without proof. The claim is H2: one reduction to the absolute case plus one identification of resolutions.
